Name: Structure
Description: Controls the influence of terrain slope on the texture, allowing highlights or patterns to follow steeper areas.

Name: Slope
Description: Controls the influence of terrain slope on the texture, allowing highlights or patterns to follow steeper areas.

Name: Flows
Description: Adds flow-based features to the texture, simulating the effect of water or material movement across the surface.

Name: Soil
Description: Introduces soil-like patterns or noise, adding organic variation to the texture.

Name: Patches
Description: Controls the presence and size of patchy areas within the texture, creating irregular or clustered features.

Name: Chaos
Description: Adjusts the randomness and disorder in the texture, increasing natural variation and reducing uniformity.

Name: Peaks
Description: Emphasizes or introduces features that follow terrain peaks, adding detail to high areas in the texture.

Name: Processing
Description: Enhances specific features or contrasts in the texture, making details more pronounced.

Name: Accentuate
Description: Enhances specific features or contrasts in the texture, making details more pronounced.

Flubs.Name: Off
Flubs.Description: No accentuation is applied; the texture remains unmodified.

Flubs.Name: Old
Flubs.Description: Applies the legacy accentuation method, increasing contrast and detail using the previous algorithm.

Flubs.Name: New
Flubs.Description: Uses the latest accentuation method for improved feature enhancement and clarity.

Name: Enhance
Description: Applies additional enhancement to the texture's tonal range or contrast.

Flubs.Name: Autolevel
Flubs.Description: Automatically adjusts the levels to maximize the full tonal range, improving contrast.

Flubs.Name: Equalize
Flubs.Description: Equalizes the histogram, distributing intensity values more evenly for a balanced look.

Name: Reverse
Description: Inverts the black and white values of the texture, swapping dark and light areas.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for generating the texture. Changing the seed produces different pattern variations.
